channel.title: The 2025 Shutdown: A Constitutional Crisis Brewing in Plain Sight
channel.description: An analysis of the 2025 federal government shutdown as a constitutional crisis

item.title: The 2025 Shutdown: A Constitutional Crisis Brewing in Plain Sight
item.description: At 12:01 a.m. on October 1, 2025, the United States government faced a familiar crisis: a partial shutdown. The fiscal year had ended, and Congress hadn't passed new funding. But this wasn't just another budget squabble; it felt like something more fundamental was at stake.
item.author: stilesseymens@example.com (Stiles Seymens)
